description: This file defines a TRPC router for attribute-related operations, including queries and mutations, with dynamic imports of handler modules.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Query to list attributes, dynamically importing the handler.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Query to get a specific attribute using getAttributeSchema.

methods.name: getByUserId
methods.description: Query to get attribute info by user ID.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Mutation to create an attribute with access control.

methods.name: edit
methods.description: Mutation to edit an attribute with access control.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Mutation to delete an attribute with access control.

methods.name: toggleActive
methods.description: Mutation to toggle attribute active state.

methods.name: assignUserToAttribute
methods.description: Mutation to assign a user to an attribute.

methods.name: bulkAssignAttributes
methods.description: Mutation for bulk assigning attributes to users.

methods.name: findTeamMembersMatchingAttributeLogic
methods.description: Query to find team members matching attribute logic.
